apps.name: Sample Size
apps.subtitle: Your clothing taste and design workspace
apps.localizedDescription: An early offline clothing workspace with personal and brand taste lanes, swiping, saved collections, design reviews, and export. Includes 113 bundled references and design images. Live shopping feeds and automatic website sync are still in development. Unsigned: sign and install with your own Feather certificate. Requires iOS 16.4 or later.

privacy.usageDescription: Allow SampleSize to access your Face ID biometric data.
